title: DOW-UAP-PR21, Unresolved UAP Report, Iraq, May 2022
doc_notes: This document is a declassified mission report (MISREP) from the 50th Attack Squadron detailing an ISR mission over the Eastern Mediterranean and Syria in May 2022, containing heavy redactions under 1.4(a) and FOIA exemptions.

incidents.summary: An unidentified small UAP was observed flying north to north east by a military asset.
